summary: Validated all 5 flows from Iteration 41 review request: Wave webhook (success+persistence+idempotency), Wave webhook rejection (missing client_reference + unknown order), Rider heading end-to-end (POST /api/riders/location with heading/speed/battery → GET /api/public/order/{code}/rider-position returns simulated=false, heading=45, speed=4.5), Footer brand SVG logos (Facebook/WhatsApp/TikTok all SVG, correct hrefs, not Lucide) + floating storefront-whatsapp button on white rounded background, and SubdomainRouter smoke on preview URL (no console errors).
critical_code_review_comments: Wave webhook signature verification is skipped if no Wave-Signature header is sent even when wave_webhook_secret is configured — current implementation only enforces signature if BOTH secret is set AND header is present (line 4886). Consider rejecting unsigned requests when a secret is configured to avoid bypass by omitting the header.
RiderLocationIn exposes battery_level/battery_charging but no validation range (level 0-100). Low-risk; consider Pydantic Field constraints.
